benchmark.interpretation: Local measurements for specified synthetic workloads, not cross-language or hardware comparisons.
benchmark.methodology: Fresh manager per repetition; compilation and exact counting included; no warmup removed.

optimality_reference.method: explicit source-world belief states and exhaustive stopping actions

temporal_mission.time_convention: States exist at times zero through horizon; uptime accrues before each transition.

source.policy: All files in lib, bin, tools, t, examples, docs and .github plus root metadata. Runtime, build and evidence outputs are excluded.

payload.trust: Unsigned reproducibility receipt. Integrity is not authenticity.
